critique.evidence: Strong cyber-lab art direction, disciplined cyan/amber accents, and clear headline-to-results hierarchy. However, desktop feels compositionally unbalanced: the oversized low-information scope graphic consumes nearly half the main card while the evidence panel is cramped, with the rightmost 100% metric visibly clipped. Tablet is cleaner, but mobile becomes excessively dense with tiny mono labels, long hashes, tight evidence rows, and a visually crowded header whose navigation is cut off. Several muted gray labels also look borderline faint against the near-black background.
critique.fix: On desktop, narrow the decorative scope panel or widen the results column so all three primary metrics fit without clipping. On mobile, increase supporting-text size and contrast, simplify hashes/evidence rows, add more vertical rhythm, and replace the clipped horizontal header rail with a clearer compact navigation pattern.
